name: Rack focus to background
summary: Moves attention without moving the frame: from a person to what they are looking at, from a product to its context.

data.about: The camera stays still while the sharp plane slides from the subject to the background; layers blur by their distance from it (`depthBlur`).
data.avoid: Flat footage (a filmed shot cannot be refocused: this needs layers Moovi builds); scenes with only one depth.
